description.en:
Starts changing a screen's brightness to a target level over a number of frames. The call returns straight away; use CMND_IS_BRIGHT_FADE to wait for it.

Brightness -1.0 is fully black and 0.0 is the normal picture.
Screens use SCREEN_A (0, top), SCREEN_B (1, bottom) and SCREEN_AB (2, both).
While an event has its bottom-screen background loaded (the EvSubBg image), a fade asked for SCREEN_A is applied to the top and bottom screens instead.

The ev_main helper StartBrightFade wraps this call together with the waiting loop.
Screen to fade: SCREEN_A (0), SCREEN_B (1) or SCREEN_AB (2).
Target brightness: -1.0 for black, 0.0 for the normal picture.
Length of the fade, in frames.

true once the fade has been started.
null if the engine is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments were given.

examples.case: One screen or both, then wait (real usage, the body of ev_main's StartBrightFade)

examples.code:
// Return the top screen to its normal brightness over 15 frames
CMND_BRIGHT_FADE(SCREEN_A, 0.0, EV_FADE_SLOW);
